race.comment: TEN WARRIORS (5) is the one to beat after a strong first-up second at Geelong, where he was beaten half a length after settling well back and meeting interference late. His form last time was consistent and reads well for this. SOME PEOPLE CALLME (3) resumes with two trials behind him, a solid 1200m record and notable gets Damian Lane aboard who has a good strike rate for the stable. CATTLE CAMP (11) had little room when beaten a neck at this venue last start and gets weight relief. Will take holding out from the low gate. YUM (6) has been out of the winner's list for a while, last start finishing fourth at Geelong over 1300m. Will get back but should be running on late and can be competitive.
